pages.text: Several mods wanted the same keys. Emberveil ships these defaults so nothing fires twice:

$(li)Minimap "new waypoint" moved from B to N (B opens your backpack).$(li)Cataclysm helmet ability moved from C to X, chestplate from Y to J, boots from V to R.$(li)Simply Tooltips' tab cycling moved from G to the ` key (G opens accessories).
$(li)Iris "reload shaders" is unbound (R shows recipes in inventories).$(li)Simply Tooltips' GIF capture is unbound (H opens this book).

Every one of these can be changed back in Options > Controls > Key Binds. Unbound items that you may want to bind: Better Combat's feint, and the Artifacts toggles (night-vision goggles, magnet, charms).
